name: Private Bodyguard
description: Four popular boys, who are also brothers, are shocked when an orphan girl they often fight at school is suddenly adopted by their parents, but as they grow closer, they might find that having a sister to protect and becomes their voice of reason might be exactly what they needed.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Fely's arrival at her new school is marked by conflict with 4 Princes, the four most popular brothers in school. But what Fely doesn't realize is that this will only be the beginning of her conflict with the 4 Princes, namely Raga, Jordan, Helga and Naviro. A much greater conflict awaits.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Raga, Helga and Naviro try hard to undo their father's plans. But Jordan does not necessarily agree with the attitude of his brothers.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Raga, Helga and Naviro do even crazier pranks towards Fely, while Jordan's sympathy for her gets Fely's admiration, and burning Raga's anger towards his brother.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Fely decides 4 Princes will never accept her while Helga and Naviro begin to show divisions.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Helga and Naviro fight for their love while Raga suddenly inserts himself between Fely and Jordan.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Raga and Fely are suddenly faced with a crisis that could expel them while Chloe also prepares a plan to deal with Fely.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Chaos ensues in the school's field trip, as Chloe begins to sniff the secret between Fely and the 4 Princes.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Fely becomes the No. 1 laughing stock as Raga makes a decision that surprises Jordan.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Raga and Fely are looking for the culprit behind Fely's video. Jordan and Fely's relationship becomes tenuous, while Hema silently tries to help Fely.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Fely, aided by Hema, tries to clear her name from the embarrassment of Chloe's actions, while a conflict threatens to split Raga and Jordan.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Fely got a surprise that she never expected, yet a heart-breaking surprise for The 4 Princes.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Fely leaves 4 Princes and lives her new life with Andre, while Johan and Raga begin to suspect that things are not what they expected.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Raga investigates what happened to Fely. Jordan and the other 4 Princes did not stand still, while the danger to Fely began to become a reality.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: 4 Princes and Fely work together to save themselves. But what they don't realize is that Johan is also in danger.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Fely made a decision that broke her own heart. A decision that must be accepted by 4 Princes. Despite that, one of the 4 Princes will make his last attempt to turn things around.
